command: method_pipeline_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_utility.method_pipeline (id)
observation_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES observation.observation (id)
edna_asv_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observation.edna_asv (id)

sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS edna_asv_taxon_idx ON observation.edna_asv (taxon_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS edna_asv_abundance_asv_idx ON observation.edna_asv_abundance (edna_asv_id);
COMMENT ON COLUMN observation.edna_asv.asv_key IS 'Delivery key when no sequence is available (<group>-<row number in source sheet>); only stable while the laboratory keeps the row order';
COMMENT ON COLUMN observation.edna_asv.taxon_id IS 'Deepest resolved taxon of the ASV lineage';
COMMENT ON COLUMN observation.edna_asv_abundance.read_count IS 'Rarefied read count; the rarefaction depth is the rarefaction_depth parameter of the pipeline diversity step';
COMMENT ON COLUMN observation.edna_asv_abundance.raw_read_count IS 'Unrarefied read count from the feature table, when delivered';
